Joe Root Becomes Second Fastest to 23,000 International Runs

England batter Joe Root has become the second fastest to complete 23,000 international runs, surpassing Sachin Tendulkar in this milestone. Root achieved this record during the first ODI against Sri Lanka while playing for England. He is now second on the list for the fastest to reach this aggregate of runs.
